baseline.vulnerability_class: Server-side template injection against a restricted template context
baseline.learning_objective: identify that attacker-controlled template expressions are evaluated against server-side context
baseline.prerequisite_knowledge: basic HTTP requests and template-expression injection

shortcut.description: a stateless preview endpoint accepts the complete winning template expression in one request with no application state
shortcut.reduction_check: the old stateless preview request is rejected while a stored attacker-controlled draft using the same template expression still reaches the runtime flag

transformation.summary: require one ordinary draft-creation action before the same attacker-controlled template is rendered
